$comment: Charged-shot tuning (brief §4). Each scaling curve is piecewise-linear [charge 0..1, multiplier] points: 1x at 0% → max at 100%.

shell.$artillerySplash: Arcing shells never score a 'direct' hit; their blast deals artillerySplash x damage at the centre, falling to 0 at the edge.
shell.$terrainDamageMul: Shell damage x this hits destructible terrain. 0.04 = 1/25 keeps wall/crate durability unchanged after the x25 hp/damage scale (D-027).

targeting.$comment: Auto turret targeting. switchRatio: a new candidate must be closer than switchRatio x current target distance to take over (0.9 = 10 % closer). A locked target outside the gun's range is dropped at once for a visible enemy inside the range (round-02).
